messages.content: 我在檢索的發票上出現了一筆意外的費用。如果可能的話，能否請有人聯繫客服，提供詳細資訊，希望能解決這筆在發票上發現的意外費用？

messages: ChatCompletionMessage(content=None, refusal=None, role='assistant', annotations=None, audio=None, function_call=None, tool_calls=[ChatCompletionMessageFunctionToolCall(id='chatcmpl-tool-af97bfe0fbd8569b', function=Function(arguments='{"booking_id": "flight_001", "message": "I noticed an unexpected charge on my invoice. Could someone please look into this?"}', name='contact_customer_support'), type='function')], reasoning='The user wants to contact customer support about an unexpected charge. We have a function contact_customer_support. It requires booking_id and message. We need to provide booking_id. We know booking_id is flight_001. So we can call contact_customer_support with booking_id "flight_001" and message explaining the unexpected charge.')

messages.content: {"customer_support_message": "Thank you for contacting customer support. Your message has been received and we will get back to you shortly."}

messages.content: 客戶支持並未完全解決我的問題，現在我有點沮喪。如果能夠啟動一個標題為「帳單問題」的優先級 2 工單，並包含與客戶支持的詳細交流，我將不勝感激，以便我們能夠適當地升級此事。詳細內容為「與客戶支持關於意外收費的詳細交流。」
